items.summary_en: A team in China tested a chemogenetic approach in three patients, combining gene delivery with a drug to suppress neuronal activity and control seizures. These early clinical observations do not establish effectiveness or safety in broader populations.

items.zh: 人类活动减少，生物多样性会怎样变化？
items.en: When humans disappear, biodiversity takes a surprising turn
items.summary_zh: 保护自然常强调减少人类干扰，但Nature的这篇报道提醒，在某些地区，人口减少也可能威胁生物多样性。这为理解人与生态系统的关系提供了另一种视角：保护策略需要考虑当地社会与环境背景，而不能简单假设人类退出就一定有利于自然。
items.summary_en: Conservation often focuses on reducing human pressure, yet depopulation can also threaten biodiversity in some places. This feature examines why the relationship between people and ecosystems depends on local conditions, challenging the assumption that human withdrawal always benefits nature.

items.zh: 降低脂蛋白(a)，为何未必转化为临床获益？
items.en: Why did a promising cholesterol drug disappoint in a clinical trial?
items.summary_zh: 针对心血管危险因素脂蛋白(a)的降脂疗法曾受到广泛期待，但Nature报道，一项重要临床试验未能显示预期获益。报道围绕这一落差提出问题：降低风险指标与改善患者结局之间，仍需要临床证据连接；这一结果对相关疗法的意义仍待厘清。
items.summary_en: Therapies targeting lipoprotein(a) attracted considerable interest, but a major trial did not demonstrate the anticipated benefit. Nature examines the uncertainty this creates for the field, highlighting the distinction between changing a risk marker and improving patient outcomes.

items.zh: 如何更早发现表现异常的新发疫情？
items.en: Recognizing unexpected outbreaks sooner
items.summary_zh: Nature的一篇评论讨论了新发疫情监测的盲点：当疾病出现不常见或出乎预期的症状时，现有监测措施可能难以及时识别。作者提出五项容易被忽视的改进思路，提醒公共卫生体系关注超出现有疾病模式的异常信号。
items.summary_en: This commentary discusses a limitation of outbreak surveillance: unusual or unexpected symptoms can escape existing monitoring approaches. Its five proposed steps emphasize recognizing signals that do not fit familiar disease patterns.
